patch.content:
menu "Input drivers"

config INPUT_KBD_MATRIX
    bool "Keyboard Matrix Driver"
    depends on HAS_HW_PINMUX || HAS_DT_GPIO
    help
      Enable the keyboard matrix driver.

if INPUT_KBD_MATRIX

config INPUT_KBD_MATRIX_THREAD_STACK_SIZE
    int "Keyboard matrix driver thread stack size"
    default 1024
    help
      Stack size for the keyboard matrix driver thread.

config INPUT_KBD_MATRIX_THREAD_PRIORITY
    int "Keyboard matrix driver thread priority"
    default 5
    help
      Priority for the keyboard matrix driver thread.

config INPUT_KBD_MATRIX_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
    int "Keyboard matrix driver poll interval (ms)"
    default 10
    depends on !INPUT_KBD_MATRIX_INTERRUPT
    help
      Polling interval in milliseconds for the keyboard matrix driver.
      Only applicable when not using interrupt mode.

config INPUT_KBD_MATRIX_INTERRUPT
    bool "Enable interrupt-driven keyboard matrix"
    depends on HAS_DT_GPIO_FLAGS_AS_INT
    help
      Enable interrupt-driven scanning for the keyboard matrix.
      Requires row GPIOs to be configured as interrupt-capable.

config INPUT_KBD_MATRIX_DEBOUNCE_MS
    int "Keyboard matrix debounce time (ms)"
    default 5
    help
      Debounce time in milliseconds for key presses.

config INPUT_KBD_MATRIX_REPORT_RELEASE_ON_DEBOUNCE
    bool "Report key release on debounce"
    default y
    help
      If enabled, a key release event will be reported after the debounce
      period if the key is no longer pressed. If disabled, the key release
      is reported immediately when the key is detected as released.

endif # INPUT_KBD_MATRIX

endmenu
